emails.subject: Today's breakfast at your Raffles Place shop
emails.text:
Dear Nanyang Kopi & Toast team,

I ate Set A at your Raffles Place shop during today's trial and was sick afterwards. I saw a doctor, and the clinic bill came to $85. I am recovering at home now.

I am not writing to make a scene. I liked the shop, and I would like to know what happened and what you are doing about it. I plan to post a review tomorrow night after I have heard from you.

Regards,
Priya Nair

emails.subject: Goodwill payment cover for the Raffles Place opening
emails.text:
Dear Wei Ling,

For the customer who reported feeling unwell after the trial, your policy allows a goodwill payment of up to $3,000 without any admission of fault. Keep the signed disposal log and the fridge log with the claim.

Regards,
Lion City Insurance Claims

emails.subject: Post about Nanyang Kopi & Toast is being shared
emails.text:
Hi Daniel,

One of the old regulars' nephews posted that Nanyang has forgotten its roots after seeing the new kopi prices. The post has been shared a few hundred times since last night, about 300 shares, and it is still moving in the local groups.

We thought you should know before the shop opens.

Raffles Place Community Page

emails.subject: Direct order code for our offices
emails.text:
Hi Daniel,

12 office managers in the building have asked for a direct order code so our teams can collect breakfast without going through the delivery app. Most of our orders are for five sets or more.

Please let us know what you decide for opening day.

One Raffles Place Offices

emails.subject: Notice of routine food hygiene inspection - Raffles Place (11 November, 9:00 AM)
emails.text:
Dear Licensee (Nanyang Kopi & Toast - Raffles Place),

This is your routine opening-day kitchen inspection, booked on 21 October 2026 as part of the standard licensing schedule. It is not a response to any customer report. An officer will conduct the on-site inspection on 11 November at 9:00 AM.

The officer will ask for the signed disposal log, the fridge temperature log, and the order details for the replacement eggs and kaya.

Regards,
Food Agency Central Regional Inspection Team

emails.subject: Confirmed: visit at 10:30 on 11 November
emails.text:
Hi Daniel,

Confirmed for 10:30 tomorrow morning at the Raffles Place shop. I would like to photograph Set A, the kopi bar and the breakfast crowd. I read the local Facebook groups, so I have seen the post about the old regulars; I will ask about it.

See you at 10:30,
Jia Hui

emails.subject: Launch deal: featured banner while the full menu is live
emails.text:
Dear Nanyang Kopi & Toast team,

Your opening-day launch deal includes a featured banner on the breakfast page. The banner stays only while the full menu is live.

Our opening-month discount on commission ends on 10 November, so commission from 11 November is 32%. A $10 set delivered returns $6.80 before the $7.30 cost of making and packing it. Please also note that shops priced more than 10% above in-store are hidden from search; five-set platters are treated as a separate catering item.

GrabFood Key Accounts Singapore
